adjudicability_gate.rule: No semantic disposition may be computed unless every planned observation is ACCEPTED and every paired A/B cell is complete.

A_COMBINED_ONTOLOGY_CLARIFIED.description: Exact ontology-clarified combined proposal condition from Ontology 002 Arm B. Candidate span only; full frozen Interpretation Proposal output surface remains active.
A_COMBINED_ONTOLOGY_CLARIFIED.ontology_clarification:
ONTOLOGY CLARIFICATION FOR THIS OUTPUT CONTRACT:
The field name `normative_force` is used here for all six allowed institutional relation labels, not only deontic modalities. `CONSTITUTIVE_DEFINITION` is therefore the required `normative_force` label when, and only when, the literal proposition itself constitutes what a term means. This label is provisional description only: it does not establish authority or canonical institutional meaning. Infer it only from the proposition; do not infer or resolve anything from outside text.

B_FORCE_ONLY_ONTOLOGY_CLARIFIED.description: Candidate span only; same six-label relation ontology and same constitutive-definition clarification, but no slot extraction. The model returns one provisional force label only.
B_FORCE_ONLY_ONTOLOGY_CLARIFIED.system_prompt:
You classify. You do not decide.

You are given one institutional proposition that has already been admitted for
interpretation. Admission does not establish what it means.

Your only task is to propose the institutional relation expressed by the literal
proposition.

Inspect only the proposition supplied. Do not use outside facts, institutional
practice, authority metadata, source identity, or an expected answer.

The allowed provisional relation labels are exactly:
OBLIGATION
PROHIBITION
PERMISSION
CONSTITUTIVE_DEFINITION
DELEGATION
ADVISORY

ONTOLOGY CLARIFICATION FOR THIS OUTPUT CONTRACT:
The field name `normative_force` is used here for all six allowed institutional
relation labels, not only deontic modalities. `CONSTITUTIVE_DEFINITION` is
therefore the required `normative_force` label when, and only when, the literal
proposition itself constitutes what a term means. This label is provisional
description only: it does not establish authority or canonical institutional
meaning. Infer it only from the proposition; do not infer or resolve anything
from outside text.

Return exactly one JSON object with exactly one key:
{"normative_force":"<ONE_ALLOWED_LABEL>"}

Return no explanation, confidence, score, status, authority claim, identifier,
slot extraction, or other key.
B_FORCE_ONLY_ONTOLOGY_CLARIFIED.user_prompt_template:
Classify only the provisional institutional relation expressed by this admitted proposition.

Return exactly {"normative_force":"<ONE_ALLOWED_LABEL>"}.

ADMITTED PROPOSITION:
{candidate_span}

claim_ceiling: This experiment may characterize whether a force-only task is more reliable than the combined proposal task for one model/provider on six frozen synthetic admitted propositions. It does not establish canonical meaning, interpretation authority, legal validity, production staging, a schema split, a revised Institutional IR ontology, cross-model generalization, or an architectural change.
competing_explanations: generative task interference between force classification and slot extraction
model/provider instability at the classification boundary

control_endpoint.metric: Correct force classification on delegation, advisory, and permission controls.

required_materialization_checks: all 36 planned requests materialize without exception
Arm A request semantics remain identical to Ontology 003
Arm B substitutes only the literal {candidate_span} token
Arm B runtime prompt preserves the literal JSON example exactly
execution_repair.required_renderer: literal substitution of the exact token {candidate_span} only

interleaving: Within each specimen/run pair: odd run A then B; even run B then A.

primary_endpoint.metric: Correct provisional normative-force classification on the nine primary definition observations.
primary_endpoint.paired_metric: Count of primary A/B pairs in which force-only B is correct and combined A is incorrect, versus the reverse direction.

purpose: Discriminate whether residual constitutive-definition force failures are consistent with interference from performing force classification and multi-slot extraction in one generative proposal operation.
retry_policy: none; exactly one provider call per planned request
secondary_descriptive_endpoints: per-specimen 3-run force stability for each arm

semantic_decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: Adjudicable and no control regression, but none of the stronger directional rules above is satisfied.
semantic_decision_rule.REFUTES_FORCE_ONLY_ADVANTAGE: No control regression, but combined Arm A is correct and force-only Arm B is incorrect in at least 2 paired primary observations.
semantic_decision_rule.SUPPORTS_TASK_INTERFERENCE_HYPOTHESIS: No control regression; force-only Arm B is correct on at least 8/9 primary observations; and Arm B improves at least 2 paired primary observations over combined Arm A.

semantic_hypothesis: Force classification and slot extraction may interfere when required in one generative proposal operation. If that is materially responsible for the residual failures observed in 002, an ontology-clarified force-only task should classify primary definitions more reliably than the ontology-clarified combined proposal task while preserving controls.
